1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with adequate letter and line spacing, though the spacing is standard rather than notably generous.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense text blocks appear anywhere; all labels and instructions are short sentence-case lines.

3.why: Content is presented in a single narrow column with large fields and buttons that fit a mobile viewport and remain readable.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Enter the six-digit code delivered to your verified mobile number' are brief and written in plain language.

5.why: No placeholders or worked examples are shown in the email, phone number, or verification code fields.

6.why: Every screen contains only one or two short sentences, so no long block of text must be read to proceed.

7.why: No copy mechanism is shown for any code or secret; the SMS code must be typed by hand into the verification field.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears in any of the five screenshots.

9.why: Autofill and password-manager support cannot be confirmed or ruled out from static screenshots, and there is no password field in the flow.

10.why: Bold step headings ('Sign in to begin', 'Verify your identity') and a single prominent blue button make the current step and primary action stand out, though no step-progress indicator exists.

11.why: Each screen asks for exactly one main action via a single primary button ('Continue' or 'Verify identity').

12.why: After actions the system gives feedback — the Logs panel states 'Identity verification delivery was initiated' and the error state tells the user what happened and to try again.

13.why: The user can retry immediately after the failed attempt with the code retained, but no resend/re-request option or reveal/hide control is visible.

14.why: The error 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' is non-blaming and gives a next step, but it does not state what the actual problem was.

15.why: No countdown, timer, or expiry warning appears on any screen, so no time limit on reading or code entry is apparent.
